children: Sweden transport solutions firm's Q3 net sales rose 8% but missed analyst expectations
Adjusted operating income for Q3 grew but missed analyst expectations
Company saw organic sales growth and improved operating cash flow
Volvo Group expects FX to lift Q4 operating income by about SEK 1.3 bln vs Q4 2025
US tariff impact of negative SEK 0.7 bln in Q4 is expected to be fully offset by Section 232 MHDVP refunds
Net R&D capitalization and amortization is expected to add about SEK 4.0 bln to FY 2026 operating income
SERVICE, PRICING AND VOLUMES – Stronger service business, price realization and higher volumes lifted adjusted operating income, partly offset by mix and higher material and freight costs
IEEPA TARIFF REFUNDS – SEK 1.2 bln in refunds more than offset US tariff costs, producing a net SEK 0.2 bln positive impact
CURRENCY TAILWIND – Currency movements added SEK 970 mln to operating income
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 13 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the heavy machinery & vehicles peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Volvo AB is SEK367.50, about 18.1% above its October 22 closing price of SEK311.20
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
